senses.gloss: f. (חוּב) obligation, duty; (sub. קרבן) obligatory sacrifice, opp. נְדָבָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 2:8">Naz. II, 8</cite> <he>הרי אני נזיר ח׳</he> I am a Nazir by obligation (because the condition of my vow was fulfilled), opp. <he>נזיר נדבה</he> a voluntary nazarite without a conditional vow.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 2:8">Ib.</cite> <he>הראשון ח׳</he> in that case my first nazariteship was obligatory. Kinnim I, 1 <he>הח׳</he> the obligatory sacrifices, opp. <he>נדרים ונדבות</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 27b:17">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>תפלת … רשות או ח׳</he> is the evening prayer elective or obligatory? <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 1:1">Zeb. I, 1</cite> <he>לא עלו … לשם ח׳</he> they are not accounted to those who offered them as a compliance with the obligation under which they are.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8b">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>יוצא … ידי חוֹבָתוֹ</he> has paid his obligation (of reading the Sh’ma).

<cite ref="Berakhot 20b:7">Ib. 20ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אינו מוציא … ידי חוֹבָתָן</he> cannot be the medium through which others pay their obligation (v. <cite ref="H00231"><he>חוּב</he></cite>); a. fr. <he>חוֹבַת הגוף</he>, <he>חוֹבַת גברא</he> &c., v. <cite ref="C00456"><he>גּוּף</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00131"><he>גַּבְרָא</he></cite> &c.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:7">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>פרוש אדע חוֹבָתִי וכ׳</he> a Pharisee of the class (of those who say), ‘I want to know my obligation, and I will pay it’, expl. <he>הי דא חובתא וכ׳</he> what wrong have I done that I may do a good act to make up for it.—Pl. <he>חוֹבוֹת</he>.
Succ. 56ᵃ, v. רֶגֶל; a. e.—2) condemnation, doom.—Pl. as ab. Midr. Till. to Ps IV, 8 פותחין בח׳ begin with predictions of doom, opp. נחמות. [חוֹבָה Ch., v. חוֹבָא.]
